e:
Datura = anticholinergic toxidrome (dry skin, ↑ temp, retention, photophobia)
Antidote = physostigmine; pralidoxime is for OP poisoning

Cocaine/sympathomimetic toxidrome: tachycardia, hypertension, hyperthermia, coronary spasm
Bradycardia is not expected

Marbling = putrefaction; bacterial H₂S + Hb → sulphaemoglobin along superficial veins
Appears ~36–48 h, not 24 h

Laceration over bone c̅ sharp-edged force can mimic an incision = incised looking laceration
Tissue bridges/irregular margins give it away

Leading questions are permitted only in cross-examination
Not allowed in examination-in-chief (direct) or re-examination
Washerwoman skin (pale, wrinkled, corrugated soles) = prolonged water immersion

Superfecundation = 2 ova fertilised by separate coital acts in the same cycle (can have different fathers)
Superfetation = ova of different cycles

Exhibitionism = exposing oneself/nakedness to others for sexual gratification
Voyeurism = watching others

Classic heat stroke: hot DRY skin, temp >105°F, hypotension, CNS dysfunction
Sweating is typically absent

Marking nut (Semecarpus anacardium): active principle = bhilawanol (vesicant)
Abrin = Abrus; ricin = castor

Datura = anticholinergic toxidrome (fever, confusion, photophobia, retention)
Antidote = physostigmine (crosses BBB)

Letulle = en masse removal of organs (tongue → prostate)
Virchow = one by one; Rokitansky = in situ; Ghon = en bloc
Rokitansky (in situ) technique ↓es organ handling → preferred in infectious cases like HIV

Barberio test = picric acid c̅ semen → yellow needle-shaped spermine picrate crystals
Florence = iodine, brown crystals
Strychnine: convulsions c̅ opisthotonus & clear sensorium between spasms (glycine antagonist)

IPC 314 = death of the woman by act done c̅ intent to cause miscarriage
312 = c̅ consent; 313 = without consent
Septicaemia ↑es postmortem body temperature (also heat stroke, tetanus, pontine haemorrhage)

Viper venom = haemotoxic: local pain, swelling, blisters, profuse bleeding
Cobra = neurotoxic, little bleeding

Arsenic: garlicky breath + rice-water diarrhoea (mimics cholera) c̅ severe GI pain
Phosphorus: garlic breath c̅ luminous vomitus
Age of consent for sexual acts = 18 yrs → consent of a girl <18 is invalid (POCSO/IPC 375)

Throttling (manual strangulation): grouped finger bruises, crescentic nail marks, fracture of thyroid superior horn
Ligature strangulation = continuous groove
Zsako phenomenon = postmortem tendon reflex (muscle contracts on tapping the tendon)
Plea of insanity (IPC 84) → refer for psychiatric evaluation (fitness to stand trial); court decides
POCSO 2012 protects all children <18 yrs, boys and girls (gender-neutral)

Futile aggressive care → family meeting c̅ shared, patient-centred decision (palliative approach)
No non-beneficial interventions or placebo
